summary: Iteration 227 - Verified 5 reported bugs. 4/5 fixes confirmed working (BUG #1 expanded card view, BUG #3 live sync via finance:updated event, BUG #4 no raw-field leaks, BUG #5 light theme fully working with .dark class on html). CRITICAL: BUG #2 DebtFollowUp page is BROKEN by routing guard - /debts-followup redirects to / because resolveRoutePermission returns null (route pattern not registered in ROUTE_PERMISSIONS).

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /debts-followup always redirects to / (Dashboard). Root cause: ROUTE_PERMISSIONS array in /app/frontend/src/utils/permissions.js (lines 113-141) has NO entry matching /^\/debts-followup/. In App.js line 164-168 the <Protected> guard executes `if (!routePermission && location.pathname !== '/') return <Navigate to={fallbackPath} replace />`, so any unmatched non-root path is bounced back to /. The Sidebar item at /app/frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx:67 declares { module: 'debts', action: 'view' } but the matching ROUTE_PERMISSIONS pattern is missing.

BUG_1_expanded_card_view.details: Clicking operation card toggles data-expanded false->true. All 6 expanded data-testids render: operation-card-payment-status-expanded-{id}, total-paid-expanded, balance-expanded, account-class-expanded, supplier-total, operation-card-expanded.

BUG_3_live_sync.details: On /operations, dispatching window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('finance:updated')) triggers an API refetch within 2.5s (fetch interceptor captured a /operations or /finance call). The listener is wired correctly.

BUG_4_no_raw_field_leaks.details: Scanned /operations, /debts-followup, /accounting/firewall, /smart-pos-journal — no UUID leaks, no 'paid_full'/'partial'/'unpaid' literals (except harmless tooltip 'unpaid' on /operations), no ACCOUNT_CODE: or ACCOUNTING_TARGET: markers, no 'WORKSHOP_OPERATION', no 'pos_template', no 'operationKind', no 'reference_id' literal labels. NOTE: /debts-followup raw-text check ran on the redirected dashboard (because BUG #2 redirects), so leak inspection of the actual DebtFollowUp page is pending the routing fix.

BUG_5_light_theme.details: After setting appTheme='light' and reload, document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') === false; body bg = rgb(248,250,252); /operations page background also light (rgb(248,250,252)) instead of the previous #111111. Tailwind dark mode toggling is now correct.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix BUG #2 by adding a route-permission entry for /debts-followup in /app/frontend/src/utils/permissions.js ROUTE_PERMISSIONS array. Suggested addition near line 132: `{ pattern: /^\/debts-followup/, module: 'reports', action: 'view' }` (or use 'customers'/'operations' depending on intended RBAC). Without this, the <Protected> guard in App.js:164-168 redirects every visit back to /.

Optional: After fixing the routing, re-verify that DebtFollowUp renders customer+supplier entries and that totals header populates from /api/customers, /api/suppliers, /api/finance/chart-of-accounts (all confirmed HTTP 200).
Optional: The harmless English 'unpaid' literal appears in /operations text (probably from a status badge fallback). Consider replacing with Arabic-only label for full localization.
critical_code_review_comments: ROUTE_PERMISSIONS array (utils/permissions.js) is the single source of truth for route guarding. Any new route added to App.js MUST have a corresponding pattern here, otherwise the <Protected> guard silently redirects. Recommend adding a unit test or build-time check that cross-references React Router <Route> paths against ROUTE_PERMISSIONS to prevent recurrence.

App.js:165 redirect logic treats 'no matching permission rule' identically to 'permission denied' — these should be distinguished. Unknown routes should arguably show a 404 instead of silently going to /.

rca_of_the_issue: BUG #2 RCA: When location.pathname === '/debts-followup' is loaded, App.js Protected wrapper calls resolveRoutePermission('/debts-followup'). The ROUTE_PERMISSIONS regex list (utils/permissions.js lines 113-141) has no pattern that matches /debts-followup, so the function returns null. The next branch `if (!routePermission && location.pathname !== '/')` evaluates to true, returning `<Navigate to={getFirstAllowedRoute(session)} replace />`, which is `/` for the admin. The DebtFollowUp component is therefore never mounted. Reproduction: login as 'مدير', visit /debts-followup; URL bounces to / within one render tick. Fix: append `{ pattern: /^\/debts-followup/, module: 'reports', action: 'view' }` (or a 'debts' module if one is defined in permissions) to ROUTE_PERMISSIONS.
